parent_objective: design a new no-training action-divergent outcome-pressure route after staged warmup outcome validation failed
blocked_by: M1421 found zero warmup-history-positive outcome rows despite clean source materialization and stratified diagnostics

public_gates: M1423 must design a new evidence axis rather than continuing staged warmup retuning
M1423 must target matched-current action-divergent terminal-margin-sensitive cases
M1423 must separate action-critical rows from outcome-critical rows
M1423 must not run source smoke outcome interventions train run PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not continue local staged warmup geometry tuning
do not claim self-identification from M1421

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a new task/source route that turns action-divergent history effects into terminal outcome pressure after staged warmup outcome validation failed
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no source smoke outcome intervention training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export paper-level or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design reuses staged warmup retuning without a new evidence axis
stop if design routes directly to training or corpus export
stop if design requires actor input changes
stop if design cannot define source-diverse outcome-pressure gates
fallback_plan: pivot to benchmark/generalization cleanup if no credible outcome-pressure design exists
admit one no-training implementation only if gates and stop conditions are pre-registered
route to branch synthesis if design reveals no viable new evidence axis

admission_evidence: M1421 had 1524 action-critical rows but zero warmup-history-positive outcome rows
M1422 pivots away from staged warmup geometry retuning
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1423 must design tests that separate current-frame action changes from historical command-response necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design follows M1421 negative outcome probe.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the design cannot make history interventions outcome-sensitive without shortcuts, record that and pivot or stop instead of weakening the self-ID standard.
allowed_claims: action-divergent outcome-pressure design and next route decision
no promotion corpus export training PPO private-holdout high-fidelity paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A design that explicitly targets matched-current action-divergent and terminal-margin-sensitive cases is a better next evidence axis than further staged warmup geometry retuning.
success_criteria: design defines source-diverse action-divergent outcome-pressure gates
design pre-registers forbidden shortcuts and next route
design chooses a non-training next route without source smoke outcome intervention training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: design repeats staged warmup gate retuning without a new evidence axis
design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1423 passes if it defines a new no-training action-divergent outcome-pressure route with gates before implementation.
